title: Add member says only the gym's staff can see a member's photo, but the photo goes into MettleUp's nightly copy too
what: Under the photo on Add member the desk reads that only the gym's staff can see it. The photos are kept in an ordinary table of the main database, and the nightly backup copies every such table, so each photo also sits for 7 days in MettleUp's own storage, where anyone with MettleUp's cloud login can open it and no look is recorded. The backup's own note still says member photos are not in a copy. The photo switch is not on live yet, so no real photo is exposed today.
expected: The words match where the photo really goes, or the nightly copy leaves member photos out (or locks them) before the photo switch is turned on.
how_often: every night once member photos are switched on
fix_line: Keep member photos out of the nightly copy, or change the words to say MettleUp also holds a locked backup

title: In Hinglish, the money sheets and parts of Add member stay in English
what: With English | Hinglish set to Hinglish, Add member is mostly in Hinglish, but its photo row, the 'already has this number, archived' box with its two buttons, and the 'train at every branch' box stay English. Sell or renew, Collect payment, Freeze / extra days, Change start date and Cancel receipt have no Hinglish at all, so an owner who picked Hinglish does every money task in English.
expected: Every line on these six sheets has a Hinglish line, the same as the rest of Add member.
how_often: every time, for owners who chose Hinglish
fix_line: Add Hinglish lines for the six desk sheets and the English-only parts of Add member

title: The freeze button reads 'Add 1 days' when one day is typed
what: On Freeze / extra days the button counts the days as 'Add 7 days'. For one day it says 'Add 1 days'.
expected: 'Add 1 day' for one day, 'Add N days' otherwise.
how_often: every time one day is given
fix_line: Say 'day' when the number is one

title: The gift choice is called 'Gift – Extra days' on the sheet but saved as 'Gift - extra days'
what: The desk picks 'Gift – Extra days' (long dash, capital E), but the note saved on the membership, which the desk and member see later, reads 'Gift - extra days' (short dash, small e). Two spellings of the same thing.
fix_line: Use the same words for the choice and the saved note

title: With the days box cleared, 'Add days' is greyed out with no word saying why
what: On Freeze / extra days, if the desk clears the days box the button turns grey and reads 'Add days'. The box only shows 'A whole number from 1 to 365' when something wrong is typed, so with an empty box nothing says what is missing.
expected: An empty box also says 'Type the days, 1 to 365' next to it, or the button stays on and says so when pressed.
fix_line: Show the reason under the empty box too

title: Collect payment says 'Every membership is fully paid' when a cancelled plan still has money owing
what: When nothing is left to chase, Collect payment says the member has no dues and every membership is fully paid. Cancelled plans are left out of that check, so a member with unpaid money on a cancelled plan is also told every membership is fully paid.
expected: 'Nothing left to collect' (true either way), or a line saying a cancelled plan is not chased.
how_often: members with a cancelled plan that was not paid in full
fix_line: Change the line to say nothing is left to collect

title: What's new says Take photo works when you edit a member, but the Edit member form has no photo
what: What's new says that when you add or edit a member, Take photo uses the desk camera. The Edit member form shows no photo row at all; the photo can only be changed from the member's own page.
expected: The note says 'when you add a member, or on a member's page'.
fix_line: Change the What's new line to name the member's page
